title: Spherical capacitor shell
prompt:
CAD + FEM task. Deliver (1) part.py, a CadQuery script that writes part.step in millimetres in exactly the coordinate frame given (multi-region models: one STEP with one solid per region and shared, coincident interface faces; 2-D models: planar faces in the z = 0 plane), and (2) fem.py, a finite-element analysis of YOUR model with any open-source FEM library, set up exactly as under Analysis, that writes results.json with the listed keys and units.
